# Flo Works — ERPNext implementation for Thai businesses

> Flo Works Limited (Flo Works) implements ERPNext — the open-source ERP — for Thai SMEs and growing companies. English punch-line headings, Thai body content. One system, every function, zero license fees, Thai-ready (VAT, withholding tax, e-Tax Invoice/Receipt).

## Pages

- [Home](https://flo-erpnext.example.com/): ERPNext implementation in Thailand — one system, every function, zero license fees.
- [Services](https://flo-erpnext.example.com/services/): ERPNext services — implementation, Thai localization, data migration, customization & Frappe apps, integrations & API, training & support/AMC.
- [About](https://flo-erpnext.example.com/about/): About Flo Works — 15+ years of ERP experience, open-source conviction, working principles.
- [Blog](https://flo-erpnext.example.com/blog/): Thai articles about ERPNext for Thai SMEs.
- [Contact](https://flo-erpnext.example.com/contact/): sales@flo-works.co, +66 81 841 7480, Silom Edge, Bangkok.

- [ค่าใช้จ่ายที่แท้จริงของ ERPNext สำหรับ SME ไทย (2026)](https://flo-erpnext.example.com/blog/erpnext-cost-sme-thai/): The real cost structure of ERPNext — implementation, customization, hosting, support; no license fees.
